name: Kállósemjén (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, white and blue, with a pointed lower end, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kállósemjén (a quartered blue and yellow shield with a bird, a fish, a heart and a fleur-de-lis) between the words KÁLLÓ- above and SEMJÉN below in blue and the year 1997.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
